title: SB 177 (2015-2016 Regular Session (2015)): Voter ID; voter registration; denial for lack of proof of citizenship. (index); AN ACT concerning elections; relating to citizenship requirements for voter registration; amending K.S.A. 2014 Supp. 25-2309 and repealing the existing section.

(d_proof_of_citizenship)
(section) K.S.A. 25-2309(l)(2)
(quote) (2) A county election officer or the secretary of state shall not deny an application for registration for lack of evidence of citizenship until the division of vehicles has an operational system to verify the citizenship of an applicant for the renewal of a driver's license.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) K.S.A. 25-2309: adds a bar on denying registration for lack of citizenship evidence until the DMV has a working citizenship-verification system.
